test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 14 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In which of the following years did the Opium Act come into force to regulate the cultivation of opium poppy and manufacture of opium?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1857.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Opium Act 1857** came into force to regulate the cultivation of opium poppy and manufacture of opium.
 
• India as a monopoly of Govt. of India **Opium Act 1857 **regulated the sale of opium and poppy heads, their inter-state import & export.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Reasons for passing this act:**

 
 
• To consolidate and amend the law relating to narcotic drugs.
 
• To make stringent provisions to control and regulate the operation relating to narcotic drugs and psychotropic substances.
 
• To considerably enhance penalties, particularly for trafficking offenses.
